messages:
Maya CSM: Heads up — AtlasPay (ATL-8321) just hit a 72% drop in daily API calls over the last 7d. Health score moved from 82 -> 41 and flagged as renewal-risk. Thinking a quick "tether" save: 4-week onboarding tether (weekly enablement + milestone credit) + a technical deep dive. Can we greenlight a credit and assign enablement?

Evan (RevOps): +1 to tether. I can approve credits up to $2k for midmarket trials. Need exact renewal date and proposed credit amount. Also attach last 7d usage chart.

Maya CSM: Renewal window is 2026-06-12. Proposal: $1.5k credit unlocked on hitting +30% weekly usage by end of tether. I'll paste the minimal usage chart here: 

    last 14d usage: [120, 115, 110, 98, 45, 40, 38, 36, 34, 32, 28, 26, 24, 22]

Anya (Eng): I can join the technical deep-dive. Quick troubleshooting checklist I can run before the call: 
1) confirm API key rotation isn't dropping requests
2) verify model routing fallback isn't increasing latency
3) check KV cache warmup behavior on their largest cohort
If you share recent logs I can prereview.

Maya CSM: Sample curl to pull their last logs (sanitized):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/customers/ATL-8321/metrics?window=7d"
```
Excerpt: `2026-04-02T14:02:13Z 200 ok req_id=xyz tokens=124 latency_ms=34` then a cluster of 5xx around 2026-04-07 03:12:xx from a single IP.

Ben R: I'll draft a short outreach and milestone doc. Proposed subject: "AtlasPay — quick sync + usage boost plan". Body (short): "Hey [Name], noticed a recent dip — we'd love to run a 30min technical + product session to unblock integrations and offer a $1.5k credit if usage rebounds by 30% in 30 days. Can you join Tue 10am PT?"

Maya CSM: Sent to customer, they accepted Tue 10am PT. Adding agenda: 10m quick health, 15m integration deep-dive (Anya), 5m immediate next steps.

churn-bot: Created ticket CS-4879 and set SLA=48h. Labels: ensure-onboarding, renewal-risk, credit-approved.

Evan (RevOps): Confirming credit: $1,500 one-time, expires 30 days after issue, conditional on +30% weekly active API calls. I'll attach the credit to CS-4879.

Anya (Eng): Pre-call request: can someone export the last 3 days of request headers and a sample of failed traces? I'll scan for 401/429 patterns and model fallback spikes. If it's rate-limiting we can suggest a conservative client-side backoff.

Maya CSM: Uploading logs to CS-4879 now. Also adding an onboarding playbook checklist in the ticket: 
- Invite & agenda sent
- Join deep-dive (Anya)
- Run integration fixes within 72h if found
- Check-in 7d after with usage snapshot
- Unlock credit after 30d milestone success

Ben R: Outreach template and milestone doc attached to ticket. I also added an enablement calendar invite for 10am Tue.

Anya (Eng): I spun up a quick shared health dashboard (read-only link) for AtlasPay that shows request rate, 5xx rate, latency percentiles, and model variant routing. Sharing in ticket.

Maya CSM: :thumbsup: Great coordination. I'll run the follow-ups and post outcome here after the session. If we hit blockers, escalate to growth-eng and legal for credit terms.

Evan (RevOps): I'll monitor CS-4879 and mark credit as pending release.

Maya CSM: Thanks team — moving to execution. Will report back with results in thread 1800002000 after the 7-day check-in.
